kypo_human.protocol: fixed C=1; five participant-disjoint folds; known task labels; 20 galleries per query; one same-task and four other-task candidates; different query/candidate participants; training-only transformations
kypo_human.uncertainty: 5000 participant-cluster resamples, recompute task macro after averaging repeated draws
kypo_human.labels: same source variant and training level; Human-only known-task retrieval

error_strata.protocol: 50% role mixture, fixed original predictions; average allocations within query task before 10000 task-cluster resamples; all HH/HA/AA FSR and FMR contrasts retained; exploratory intervals unadjusted for multiple comparisons

execution_mode_recognition.source: AIT / AECID Linux audit logs; separate from the 1,407 trace catalog records
execution_mode_recognition.interpretation: Labels are entangled with task and capture process; this is a dataset-label baseline, not validated person or agent identification.

ctf_mixture_association.bootstrap_unit: challenge task; each task is averaged over 100 repeated role allocations first

cross_source_same_challenge_human_query.task_join: normalized CyBench slug only; fixture equivalence unverified

method.name: Command TF-IDF + artifact containment
method.score: 0.45 × command TF-IDF similarity + 0.55 × training-IDF-weighted containment of distinctive artifact-name tokens in the shorter trace
method.threshold_selection: Select the cutoff from inner task-grouped out-of-fold predictions within each outer fold; the selected score was artifact containment plus command TF-IDF in all three folds.

dataset.label_scope: Same benchmark-qualified CTF task as a retrieval proxy, not actor, campaign, organization, or identity.
dataset.reuse_boundary: Task groups were used during method development; results are exploratory and not independent confirmation.

zero_miss_sensitivity.interpretation: Independent-task-cluster sensitivity bound for the share of task groups with any missed link; not a confidence interval for task-macro false-split rate.

limits: The 75.87% false-merge rate remains too high for attribution.
Human terminal records and Agent tool-call records use different collection interfaces, so execution mode is confounded with capture format.
